entry_points.summary: Final-gate cross-LLM review: two consultant subagents on cumulative diff vs plan contract; surfaces implementation_drift (Prong A) and spec/intent gaps (Prong B); use after /z-execute completes
Canonical finding class enum: implementation_drift | spec_gap | completed_task_contradiction | premise_failure | observation; shared with /z-audit-plan Phase 4

Promote findings to REVIEW-TASKS.md: implementation_drift->candidate_task, spec_gap->amendment_proposal, completed_task_contradiction->superseding_task, premise_failure->escalation, observation->evidence only
Auto-amend: unconditionally applies every amendment_proposal (spec_gap) via /z-amend --skip-user-gate; logs to auto-amend-log.md; emits auto_amend_applied per amendment; skips [x] tasks
Amendment brief: builds corrections (from Phase 6.5 spec_gaps) + approach_concerns (from premise_failure escalations) JSON; calls scripts/amendment-brief.py; writes amendment-brief.md to archive
Skip gate: if both corrections and approach_concerns are empty, skip Phase 6.6 entirely — no brief file, no pipeline entry
Finalize prefers amendment-brief.md over older approach seed when the file is present in the archive

invariants: Class enum at line 716 is the single source of truth; /z-audit-plan Phase 4 reuses it
Phase 6.5 auto-amend is unconditional for amendment_proposal tasks; no per-finding popup
Phase 6.5 never touches [x] completed tasks and never auto-implements code changes
Phase 6.6 skipped when both corrections and approach_concerns are empty
Phase 6.6 calls scripts/amendment-brief.py — the same shared renderer as /z-audit-plan
amendment-brief.md in archive triggers APPROACH_FILE preference in Finalize over the older seed
## Escalations heading in REVIEW-TASKS.md is preserved as archive record; amendment-brief.md is the active presentation layer
auto_amend_applied telemetry event emitted per successful amendment in Phase 6.5
z_review_all_verdict telemetry event emitted at Finalize with full counts
gotchas: Phase 6.5 auto-amend is unconditional — no workflow.audit_to_amend gate here; that gate lives in /z-audit-plan Phase 5 only
correction/approach are human glosses; the canonical field values are spec_gap and premise_failure
REVIEW-TASKS.md contains candidate_task, amendment_proposal, superseding_task, escalation, report_only dispositions; only amendment_proposal tasks are auto-amended
Phase 6.6 skip gate checks BOTH lists empty — if only approach_concerns is empty, the corrections list still triggers a brief (with no Worth-your-eyes section)
amendment-brief.md is written to archive/$RRUN/ not $BASE/; Finalize reads it from there
the approach bullets in run-brief.json come from amendment-brief.md (Phase 6.6), not from findings.md
Phase 6.5 and Phase 6.6 require REVIEW-TASKS.md to exist; if the review was clean (shipped.md only), both phases are skipped
